# Navigation fixtures

`walking-sydney.json` is a Valhalla OSRM-format pedestrian route from Circular Quay (-33.8611, 151.2126) to Sydney Opera House (-33.8568, 151.2153), recorded from the public Valhalla demonstration service on 2026-10-23. Includes banner / voice instructions and polyline6 geometry. It is a deterministic test recording, not live directions.

Geographic data © [OpenStreetMap contributors](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright), available under ODbL. Routing generated by [Valhalla](https://valhalla.github.io/valhalla/). The tests exercise the actual Ferrostar parser and location simulation with this fixture instead of making repeated external routing requests. Fixture coordinates are public landmarks, not device location history.
